front.title: James
front.theme: FROM DUST TO A LIVING FAITH

back.hook: Grace runs to the low ground the way water does.
paragraphs: Most men read James as a list of orders. But before James asks you to do one thing, he tells you what God has done: wisdom given without reproach, a new birth by the word of truth, and four words at the heart of the letter — he gives more grace.
Twelve weeks walk James from the testing ground to the brother brought home. The works he calls for are not the price of a living faith. They are its breath.
items: The full passage in the World English Bible
Five Greek word studies, each with a Live It response
Five Life Application practices and a daily prayer
A Bottom Line and a “Lift Up Your Eyes” benediction
